scope: Only existing fixed public 3p corpus. v2 still excludes round count/index/end-game information. No personal logs, reward/value objectives, new data, App edits or test evaluation.

executionAmendment.reason: MPS unavailable in current authorized execution context. Before any corpus inference or real training; CPU executes identical dataset, parent, optimizer, RNG, schedule and acceptance criteria.

cpuComparison.equivalenceLimit: Riichi, daiminkan and every other action integer counter match. Three linked discard exact counters increase by one (aggregate exact-correct difference of one window out of1,491,635); this is not exact bitwise/count equivalence. Device/batching floating-point boundary is plausible, but aggregate reports cannot establish the cause or identify all changed predictions. Use the newly frozen CPU baseline consistently for this CPU experiment.

naturalTrainMonitor.limitation: Only23 kan positive windows in fixed natural train monitor versus predeclared minimum100. Historical full-train kan audit provides context, but this pilot monitor cannot establish kan convergence.

screening.scope: matched pilot screening for full retraining; not deployment acceptance

opportunityWeightAuditScope: Both arms report the same counterfactual riichi2-versus-control affected-window audit. weightChanged counts potential differences between the two frozen weighting rules, not weights actually changed in control; control retains its baseline weights.

metrics.opportunityScope: Choice windows only (at least two legal candidates). Action types collapse red-tile and consumed-tile choices; exact scores compare complete candidate indices. False selection rate is FP/opportunities; false positive rate is FP/actual negatives. Always-pass and pass-available model scores use only windows with a legal pass.

validation.diagnosticScope: Union of riichi-offered and daiminkan-offered windows only

riichi.parameterMismatchScope: Type-correct but exact-wrong positives; fields overlap. RedIdentityOnly means equal base tile, different red identity; moqie includes unknown origin.

scoreDiagnostics.scope: Natural unweighted NLL and logits in focal-action opportunity windows. Strata use the recorded focal type. RecordedTypeNll sums all candidates of the recorded type; bestTypeVsOtherMargin requires another type. LogitRange.zero counts all-equal scores; tiedMaximum.positive counts windows sharing the maximum. All counted logits are finite.
